integrity: All formulas concern the exact spherical law; computational samples are not proofs. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed three points, compact normalized thresholds. Density expansion is analytic; simulations only corroborate. Earlier publications established pairwise independence, triangle excess and a special exact integral; sharp first coefficient and integrated remainder are the proposed new scope. Historical priority and independent assessment remain open.
title: A universal cubic Gaussian correction for the extreme sides of random spherical triangles
